name: Shyama S. Parikh
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Waukegan, Illinois
about: A prominent attorney within her legal community, Shyama S. Parikh strives to provide her clients with the top-quality legal representation they deserve in their emotionally taxing family law matters, including divorce and dissolution, legal separation, child custody and support, paternity, adoptions and post-decree modifications, among many others. From the law office of Shyama S. Parikh, P.C., in Waukegan, Illinois, she serves residents throughout Lake County and the surrounding region.

Ms. Parikh completed her undergraduate studies in 1999, graduating with her Bachelor of Arts degree in psychology and Spanish and communications from DePaul University, and later went on to enroll at the DePaul University College of Law. During her time there, she shored up her legal and practical knowledge through her academic prowess. She received her Juris Doctor, as well as a certificate in family law, in 2002, and a year later, she obtained her license to practice law in Illinois.

A consummate professional through and through, Ms. Parikh takes on every case with the sole intention of amicably resolving her clients’ legal issues with grace and poise. She utilizes her shrewd legal acumen and talents, as well as an unwavering work ethic that stops short of nothing in giving her clients the peace of mind and respite they deserve. For her many contributions, she has been rated “Excellent” on Avvo and hosts many positive client testimonials on the site as well. She has also been recognized by the following organizations:

Ms. Parikh is closely involved with many legal organizations within her legal community, including the AWALC, the Illinois State Bar Association and the LCBA. She is admitted to practice before the United States District Courts for the Northern, Central and Southern Districts of Illinois, and is licensed to practice in Wisconsin as well.
